note: GRIME region 'Chicago' — real-data pipeline (DEM→streams→candidates→stream mask (sites confined to ±150 m of mapped OSM/NHD waterways)→region-appropriate real parameters→shipped scoring, math unchanged). Width curve: Bieger et al. 2015 JAWRA Table 3, Interior Plains. Flood: not applicable here (documented fallback). Great Lakes basin: receiving water is Lake Michigan, not an ocean estuary — estuary_dist repurposed as distance-to-receiving-water, documented
